name: WITNESS
title: Provenance Before Story
current_claim: A trustworthy witness system preserves what a source contains, what is inferred from it, what remains unverified, and what later corrections change without promoting any source beyond the work it can actually do.
source_ancestry: THE STATIC TEXTBOOK — Witness and Provenance

doors.signal: DO NOT LET THE NARRATIVE EAT THE SOURCE.
doors.story: A readable story can become less trustworthy when event, record, discovery, and interpretation are flattened together.
doors.theory: Provenance keeps evidence class, interpretation, correction, and claim limits separable.
doors.field: Compare a real source artifact with the story being told from it.
doors.return: A source-preserving intake that can be corrected without rewriting ancestry.

crossings.law: A source may cross intact without its claims being upgraded; re-entry must preserve the ancestry that produced the new source.
